crossRefs.note: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and…
They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them…
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any…

translations.web: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
translations.bsb: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
translations.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
translations.asv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
